mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the skies are clear over Fireman's Park with a temperature of 37 degrees and a waning gibbous moon overhead. Tonight will be chilly with an overnight low of 31 degrees and no rain expected.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election. All four Aldermanic District seats are up for election, and interested residents must submit their paperwork to the City Clerk by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or the craft brewing anniversary at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the local Crafty Fair takes over ART House 360, and Paddy Mac's will feature live music performances.
The Verona Police Department recently released their call report for early November. On November 4, officers handled a two-vehicle crash where one driver was arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor is the classic Snickers Swirl. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
